description: UI component suite for Angular and React on one framework-free engine: data grid, tree list, editors, forms, overlays, navigation, rich-text editor and upload under MIT; pivot grid, charts, scheduler, gantt, kanban, BPMN editor and spreadsheet viewer under a commercial license.
rules: Angular components are standalone and use signal inputs, outputs and models; import the component classes directly, there are no NgModules.
Angular packages need Angular 21.2 or newer and work without Zone.js.
In React, import the components from @oge-ui/react (or one @oge-ui/react-<family> package) and import its styles.css once.
Excel and PDF export live in lazy entry points (for example @oge-ui/grid/export-excel and @oge-ui/grid/export-pdf) and need the optional peers exceljs or jspdf with jspdf-autotable.
Pivot, charts, scheduler, gantt, kanban, BPMN and spreadsheet packages are commercial: free for evaluation and development, a license is required in production. Every other package is MIT.
In Angular, user-facing strings are overridden with each package's provideOge<Family>Config() or the per-instance messages input, not by editing markup.
